create_lars_path: create a LARS path computation that returns alphas, active variables, and coefficients along the regression path
build_lars_path_gram: build a LARS path using precomputed Gram matrix and Xy vector for sufficient statistics mode
fit_Lars_model: fit a Lars (Least Angle Regression) model on training data with optional path tracking and jitter for stability
fit_LassoLars_model: fit a LassoLars model with L1 regularization using the LARS algorithm and specified alpha parameter
cross_validate_LassoLarsCV: cross-validate a LassoLarsCV model to automatically select the optimal alpha minimizing mean squared error
